visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male presenter with glasses, wearing a black shirt, stands in a studio setting. Behind him is a brightly lit night skyline featuring Taipei 101. He gestures actively while speaking to the camera. (2) A white box overlay appears in the center showing a graphic illustration of a finger squeezing a red pimple on skin. The presenter continues talking below the graphic. (3) The graphic disappears, and the presenter is seen again from the waist up, continuing his explanation with expressive hand movements. (4) An image of a scientific paper from 'Nature Geoscience' titled 'Mantle upwelling at Afar triple junction...' appears as a large overlay on the lower half of the screen. (5) The presenter uses both hands to mimic the action of squeezing something from different directions, demonstrating the concept of tectonic pressure. (6) Colorful 3D geological diagrams and maps of the Afar region and East African Rift are shown as overlays, detailing plate movements and mantle heat. (7) The presenter holds a small black object, likely a camera clicker, while continuing his lecture-style presentation. (8) More scientific illustrations depict the crust thinning and magma rising, used to visualize the 'squeezing' process he describes. (9) The presenter returns to the full-frame view, smiling slightly and delivering his concluding remarks against the urban night background.

(5) [Subtitle]: 長了一顆地函級的超級大悶痘. (6) [Subtitle]: 這個痘痘科學上叫做地函熱柱. (7) [Subtitle]: 就是地底深處一坨超高溫的岩漿. (8) [Subtitle]: 一直想衝破地殼爆出來. (9) [Subtitle]: 以前大家以為是這顆痘痘太猛. (10) [Subtitle]: 才把地殼這層皮膚給撐裂. (11) [Subtitle]: 但一篇發表在自然地球科學的. (12) [Subtitle]: 最新研究發現完全相反. (13) [Subtitle]: 是地殼在擠痘痘. (14) [Subtitle]: 而且還是用三隻手指頭. (15) [Subtitle]: 往三個不同的方向亂擠. (16) [Subtitle]: 蛤. (17) [Subtitle]: 可能是跟我一樣看了太多擠痘痘的影片. (18) [Subtitle]: 看到上癮了英國南安普敦大學. (19) [Subtitle]: 領導的科學家團隊. (20) [Subtitle]: 為了搞懂這顆痘痘是怎麼長的. (21) [Subtitle]: 跑去附近一百多座年輕火山. (22) [Subtitle]: 採集了超過 130 個岩石樣本. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Analogy Introduction -> Scientific Evidence -> Mechanism Explanation -> Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To simplify and explain a complex scientific finding regarding mantle upwelling in East Africa by using a pimple-squeezing analogy, highlighting that tectonic plate movement 'squeezes' magma rather than the magma just bursting out.
